common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a polished casual mobile block puzzle. One sheet, exactly SIX isolated square tile sprites in a perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Each sprite centered in its own equal cell with at least 15% clear transparent gutter on every side. Top row: saturated golden yellow, vibrant cherry red, juicy lime green. Bottom row: rich turquoise, saturated royal blue, vivid grape purple. All six tiles have IDENTICAL shape, scale, lighting and frontal camera. Straight-on orthographic front view, NO isometric projection, no perspective, no rotated squares. Rounded square silhouette with only slightly rounded corners, broad bevels, visibly plump convex face, shallow but clear bottom thickness. Upper-left light, bright near-white small specular highlights retained, richly saturated colored faces and dark saturated lower bevel, no washed-out pastel faces. Clean beautifully rendered game art readable at 40 pixels. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no text, no decorative symbols, no glow, no cast shadow extending outside the tile, no extras. Canvas landscape 3:2. Material:

materials.plastic: glossy dense injection-molded toy plastic, softly pillowed face, broad smoothly rounded bevels, short crisp cream specular streak near upper edge. Friendly substantial tactile piece, not glass or gem.
materials.enamel: hard polished enamel over a beveled solid tile, flatter central face, precise thick chamfer, a narrow bright reflected band and crisp edge gleam. Jewel-like richness but no crystal facets or cut gems.
materials.caramel: translucent hard candy resin, softly pillowed face, luminous saturated inner color and refractive rim, restrained internal caustic at lower edge. Clear solid outline and readable thick body, not liquid, no bubbles or glitter.

chrome.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite sheet for our casual block puzzle. Inputs are silhouette, six color and exact layout references. Create CHROME variant, a single 1536x1024 transparent RGBA sheet: exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of six isolated square rounded block tiles, centered in equal 512x512 cells, same size and orthographic front view as references. Order top yellow gold, red, lime green; bottom turquoise, cobalt blue, purple. Keep saturated recognizable color centers; chrome is colored polished metal, broad soft silver-white diagonal reflection bands and narrow bright bevel rim. More reflective and unmistakably metallic than input enamel. Soften dark edges: colored midtone bevels, NO black bands, NO black cavities, NO grey desaturation. Identical shallow thickness and silhouette for all six, clear large central face, small rounded corners, lighting upper left. True transparent backdrop and gaps, NO background colored glow, NO cast shadows beyond silhouette, NO environment, NO text, NO labels, NO framing. Each tile entirely inside its equal cell with generous transparent margin, not touching other tiles. Crisp high quality baked reflections that read at 48 pixels.
